Create a basic response using the Responses API

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createResponseRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Explain quantum computing in one sentence.\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.createResponse(_req)
debugPrint(result.id())
debugPrint(result.status())
debugPrint(result.output())
```
